fields.Name: Get My Agent Context
fields.Description: Returns the calling user's identity, active MJ: AI Agent User Policies posture, granted AI skills, and active routine summary without requiring raw SQL.

fields.Name: AgentID
fields.Description: Optional AI Agent ID (defaults to calling agent or Chief of Staff).

fields.Name: AgentName
fields.Description: Optional AI Agent name (defaults to Chief of Staff).

fields.Name: ContextJSON
fields.Description: JSON summary of caller user, active policy, granted skills, and routines count.

fields.Name: Assemble My Briefing
fields.Description: Deterministically fans out in parallel across all Briefing-role actions bound to the agent's active permitted skills (AISkillAction.Role IN ('Briefing', 'Both')) and combines them with core pending approvals, active routines, open Agent Channels, and open suggestions.

fields.Name: AgentID
fields.Description: Optional AI Agent ID (defaults to calling agent or Chief of Staff).

fields.Name: AgentName
fields.Description: Optional AI Agent name (defaults to Chief of Staff).

fields.Name: HorizonDays
fields.Description: Lookahead horizon in days (1-30, default 7) passed to each skill briefing contributor.

fields.Name: IncludeSkillNames
fields.Description: Optional comma-separated list of skill names to restrict briefing fan-out.

fields.Name: ContributorTimeoutMs
fields.Description: Per-contributor timeout in milliseconds (default 10000, range 20-60000). Timed-out contributors return TIMEOUT without stalling peer contributors.

fields.Name: MaxContributorChars
fields.Description: Maximum serialized characters per briefing contributor payload (default 32768). Oversized payloads are truncated with Truncated, OriginalChars, and Preview.

fields.Name: BriefingJSON
fields.Description: Assembled briefing JSON combining Core state and per-skill briefing payloads.

fields.Name: List My Agent Routines
fields.Description: Lists the calling user's MJ: User Routines for the agent, with schedule mode, cron expression, timezone, next run time, and workstream key.

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: Optional routine status filter: Active, Paused, Disabled, or All (default All).

fields.Name: WorkstreamKey
fields.Description: Optional exact WorkstreamKey filter.

fields.Name: MaxRows
fields.Description: Maximum number of routines to return (1-100, default 50).

fields.Name: RoutinesJSON
fields.Description: JSON list of the user's agent routines.

fields.Name: Get Routine Run Results
fields.Description: Retrieves recent execution history (MJ: User Routine Runs) for the calling user's routines, filtered optionally by RoutineID or WorkstreamKey.

fields.Name: RoutineID
fields.Description: Optional routine ID owned by the caller.

fields.Name: WorkstreamKey
fields.Description: Optional workstream key identifying the routine.

fields.Name: MaxRows
fields.Description: Maximum number of recent runs to return (1-50, default 10).

fields.Name: RunsJSON
fields.Description: JSON summary of recent routine run results.

fields.Name: List My Pending Approvals
fields.Description: Lists pending (or filtered-status) MJ: AI Agent Requests addressed to the calling user.

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: Optional status filter: Requested (default), Approved, Rejected, Responded, Expired, or All.

fields.Name: MaxRows
fields.Description: Maximum number of approval requests to return (1-100, default 50).

fields.Name: ApprovalsJSON
fields.Description: JSON list of matching approval and coordination requests.

fields.Name: Cancel Agent Wake
fields.Description: Disables/cancels an active wake routine owned by the calling user by RoutineID or WorkstreamKey.

fields.Name: RoutineID
fields.Description: Routine ID to cancel (provide RoutineID or WorkstreamKey).

fields.Name: WorkstreamKey
fields.Description: WorkstreamKey of the wake routine to cancel.

fields.Name: Reason
fields.Description: Optional reason recorded on the cancelled routine.

fields.Name: Find Colleague
fields.Description: Searches active internal MJ Users by name or email and reports whether each colleague accepts inter-agent coordination.

fields.Name: Query
fields.Description: Colleague name, partial name, or email address to search for.

fields.Name: MaxRows
fields.Description: Maximum number of matching colleagues to return (1-25, default 10).

fields.Name: IncludeSelf
fields.Description: When true, includes the calling user in results (default false).

fields.Name: ColleaguesJSON
fields.Description: JSON list of matching colleagues with inter-agent availability flag.

fields.Name: List Available Rhythms
fields.Description: Lists offered MJ: AI Agent Rhythm Templates contributed by core or installed skills for this agent, annotated with whether the user already enabled or declined each rhythm.

fields.Name: OfferAt
fields.Description: Optional filter: Onboarding, Install, Both, or All.

fields.Name: IncludeEnabled
fields.Description: Include rhythms already enabled for the user (default true).

fields.Name: IncludeDeclined
fields.Description: Include rhythms previously declined by the user (default false).

fields.Name: RhythmsJSON
fields.Description: JSON list of available offered rhythm templates.

fields.Name: Enable Agent Rhythm
fields.Description: Materializes an offered MJ: AI Agent Rhythm Templates entry into an active recurring MJ: User Routines row for the calling user after explicit user confirmation.

fields.Name: RhythmTemplateID
fields.Description: UUID of the rhythm template to enable (or supply WorkstreamKey).

fields.Name: WorkstreamKey
fields.Description: Stable WorkstreamKey of the offered rhythm template (for example 'calendar-daily-review').

fields.Name: CronExpression
fields.Description: Optional custom 5-field cron overriding the template default.

fields.Name: Timezone
fields.Description: IANA timezone for the cron schedule (for example 'America/Chicago').

fields.Name: AgentConfigurationID
fields.Description: Optional MJ: AI Configurations UUID (or configuration name) overriding the template DefaultAgentConfigurationID for this user's routine.

fields.Name: ModelTier
fields.Description: Optional logical model tier ('Draft', 'Standard', or 'High') resolved to Fast / Standard / High Power in MJ: AI Configurations when AgentConfigurationID is not provided.

fields.Name: ConfirmedByUser
fields.Description: Deprecated self-attestation flag (ignored during agent execution — pass a server-verified ConfirmedApprovalRequestID instead).

fields.Name: ConfirmedApprovalRequestID
fields.Description: UUID of a server-verified Approved MJ: AI Agent Requests row owned by the calling user and matching the target agent. Required when an executing agent enables a recurring rhythm.

fields.Name: RoutineID
fields.Description: ID of the created or updated User Routine.

fields.Name: Manage Agent Suggestions
fields.Description: Lists, records, or updates proactive capability/rhythm suggestions in MJ: AI Agent Suggestions so declined suggestions are respected and never re-offered.

fields.Name: Operation
fields.Description: Operation to perform: List, RecordOffer, or Respond.

fields.Name: Kind
fields.Description: Suggestion category: Rhythm, Skill, Behavior, or Integration.

fields.Name: TargetKey
fields.Description: Stable deduplication key (for example a rhythm WorkstreamKey or skill name).

fields.Name: Summary
fields.Description: Concise description of the suggestion (required for RecordOffer).

fields.Name: SuggestionID
fields.Description: Suggestion UUID (optional for Respond when TargetKey is provided).

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: Status filter for List or outcome for Respond (Accepted, Declined, Expired).

fields.Name: SuggestionsJSON
fields.Description: JSON payload returned by List.

fields.Name: Open Agent Channel
fields.Description: Opens a shared, observable Agent Channel (IS-A Conversation) either between two of the caller's own personal/shared agents (via TargetAgentID/TargetAgentName, e.g., Pepper <-> Cato) or between the caller's agent and one or more colleagues' agents (via TargetUserIDs), enforcing CoordinationMode and waking peer agents under loop-guard and rate-limit bounds.

fields.Name: Topic
fields.Description: Short executive topic describing what the participating agents are coordinating on.

fields.Name: TargetUserIDs
fields.Description: Optional comma-separated list or JSON array of colleague User IDs to include in a cross-user channel. Omit when opening a channel with another personal/shared agent of the caller via TargetAgentID or TargetAgentName.

fields.Name: TargetAgentID
fields.Description: Optional UUID of the target peer AI Agent (for example another personal agent instance like Cato or FDA Clinical Scout, or a colleague's target agent).

fields.Name: TargetAgentName
fields.Description: Optional name of the target peer AI Agent (for example 'Cato', 'Pepper', 'Jarvis') when opening a channel with a sibling personal agent or colleague agent.

fields.Name: InitialMessage
fields.Description: Opening coordination message posted to the Agent Channel.

fields.Name: ReplyByISO
fields.Description: Optional ISO-8601 response deadline.

fields.Name: ConfirmedApprovalRequestID
fields.Description: Approved MJ: AI Agent Requests ID required when CoordinationMode is Coordinator during an autonomous cross-user agent run.

fields.Name: ChannelID
fields.Description: Created Agent Channel (Conversation) ID.

fields.Name: Reply In Agent Channel
fields.Description: Posts a reply into an existing Agent Channel conversation, enforcing participant membership, loop-guard/rate-limit counters, and optional resolution.

fields.Name: ChannelID
fields.Description: Agent Channel ID to post the reply into.

fields.Name: Message
fields.Description: Reply text to post into the channel.

fields.Name: ResolveChannel
fields.Description: When true, marks the channel Resolved after posting the reply.

fields.Name: ConversationDetailID
fields.Description: ID of the newly created ConversationDetail message.

fields.Name: Get Agent Channel
fields.Description: Reads an Agent Channel's details, participants, guard counters, and message transcript, or lists the caller's Agent Channels when ChannelID is omitted.

fields.Name: ChannelID
fields.Description: Optional Agent Channel ID. Omit to list the caller's Agent Channels.

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: Optional status filter when listing channels: Open, Paused For Human, Resolved, or All.

fields.Name: MaxMessages
fields.Description: Maximum number of messages to return when ChannelID is provided (1-100, default 30).

fields.Name: ChannelJSON
fields.Description: JSON channel transcript or list of channels.
